svg.text: USB cable still in the bag. Push each module into the top half so every pin has its own column. The body overhangs the top edge.
these five holes are joined inside the board: one column is one wire.
the + and − rails are joined end to end. the groove keeps top and bottom apart.
nothing is used below the groove in this build.
board turned 180°: P1 is now the top strip, pin 1 at the left
